name: smart-sprint-planner
title: Smart Sprint Planner
description: Multi-role sprint planning plugin for YouTrack 2024.3+. Supports 9 functional roles with separate composition tables, resources, and history snapshots. Plugin settings live in a dedicated widget with server-side authorization.
changeNotes:
What's new since v3.31.0

🔌 Disable planner in this project — detaching the app from a project never removed it from the planner's project picker: app data survives detachment, and the project kept being served through the main menu. A project settings manager or an administrator can now switch the planner off explicitly, with a confirmation dialog. A disabled project disappears from the picker for regular users and main-menu service stops entirely; planner data stays intact and the switch is reversible.

🔓 No lock-out — users who can re-enable the planner still see the disabled project in the picker with a “planner disabled” mark, and get a banner with an enable button instead of the planner.

🛡 Safe by construction — the flag is written only by a dedicated endpoint under the settings-manager role; saving the settings form never touches it, and a save that races with disabling answers with a clear message without losing the draft. Automatic workflow rules are not gated by the switch (a deliberate decision, named in the confirmation dialog).

widgets.name: Smart Sprint Planner
widgets.description: Planner settings for the project: functional roles and issue fields, permission groups (validation / editing / assignee assignment / history clearing), planning modes. Sprint planning itself lives in the main-menu item «Smart Sprint Planner».

widgets.name: Smart Sprint Planner
widgets.description: Sprint planning from YouTrack's main menu: pick an accessible project where the planner is set up, plan sprint composition by role, allocate tasks, review history. Permissions and settings are checked against the selected project. Includes a «Backlog» module for triaging and laying pool tasks into roles/sprint.
